Name: MAP_MIMICRY_ESTABLISHMENT_PARAM_ST
Description: Disguise SFX for the disguise effect (Elden Ring's Mimic's Veil): when it takes effect one of the three slots is picked at random by weight and its SFX replace the effect's own. NR always uses row 0: it no longer looks up a row per area, so the other rows have no effect. Retail: Elden Ring's base-game rows plus an empty row 100.

Fields.Name: Disguise Weight [0]
Fields.Description: Chance weight of disguise slot 0, relative to the other slots. 0 or less: never picked.

Fields.Name: Disguise Weight [1]
Fields.Description: Chance weight of disguise slot 1, relative to the other slots. 0 or less: never picked.

Fields.Name: Disguise Weight [2]
Fields.Description: Chance weight of disguise slot 2, relative to the other slots. 0 or less: never picked.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - Init SFX ID [0]
Fields.Description: SFX played once when disguise slot 0 starts, in place of the SpEffectVfx Start SFX.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - Midst SFX ID [0]
Fields.Description: SFX shown while disguised as slot 0 (the disguise itself), in place of the SpEffectVfx Midst SFX. Preloaded on entering the area.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - End SFX ID [0]
Fields.Description: SFX played once when disguise slot 0 ends, in place of the SpEffectVfx End SFX.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - Init SFX ID [1]
Fields.Description: SFX played once when disguise slot 1 starts, in place of the SpEffectVfx Start SFX.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - Midst SFX ID [1]
Fields.Description: SFX shown while disguised as slot 1 (the disguise itself), in place of the SpEffectVfx Midst SFX. Preloaded on entering the area.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - End SFX ID [1]
Fields.Description: SFX played once when disguise slot 1 ends, in place of the SpEffectVfx End SFX.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - Init SFX ID [2]
Fields.Description: SFX played once when disguise slot 2 starts, in place of the SpEffectVfx Start SFX.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - Midst SFX ID [2]
Fields.Description: SFX shown while disguised as slot 2 (the disguise itself), in place of the SpEffectVfx Midst SFX. Preloaded on entering the area.

Fields.Name: Mimicry - End SFX ID [2]
Fields.Description: SFX played once when disguise slot 2 ends, in place of the SpEffectVfx End SFX.
